test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

URIC - CRUI - RIUC

KIDS - SIKD - IDKS
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

URIC → CRUI → RIUC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/222840b033943ace25f803414f83104e26e8449db94b66276992e7ef8f26d052.png] 

KIDS → SIKD → IDKS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615881abfc20b7b6da902b7be62071bbb40e18f91e7d2c99d9ace761f682520a.png] 

Now,

URIC → CRUI

Here, the last letter comes to first position, and the first three letters shift one position to the right.

CRUI → RIUC

Again, the last letter comes to first position, and remaining letters shift right.

So, it is a cyclic right shift pattern.

Now, let's check each Option One by One.

**Option 1) FADE → EAFD → ADFE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5384abb7c6a1e6b64084ea95d3cf92dfdbae668d971a2a4d99e18f9a749343c.png] 

Option 2) OPEN → OEPN → NEPO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9629126bdcf79e0252fbf58f47cafc5deb3aa3fe75613b75cffe280c99f75900.png] 

Option 3) NAVY → YANV → VANY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a4ec34608ac8b089b9a616fcd068123c2cecde10bbd4b8874a96e614b722335.png] 

Option 4) MALE → AMLE → EALM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71438bb42ae6e1b7aa79ce97d75bea6375a852c29b4a1fe08bddfaeb20599858.png] 

So, Only FADE → EAFD → ADFE** **follows the pattern of given letter cluster.

Hence, the correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**
